# Psalm 122 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA (Council Arbiter) | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A Song of Ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD!"

**2** Our feet have been standing within your gates, O Jerusalem!

**3** Jerusalem — built as a city that is bound firmly together,

**4** to which the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

**5** There thrones for judgment were set, the thrones of the house of David.

**6** Pray for the peace of Jerusalem! "May they be secure who love you!

**7** Peace be within your walls and security within your towers!"

**8** For my brothers and companions' sake I will say, "Peace be within you!"

**9** For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

---
## Council Notes

SOPHIA detected **6** significant divergence(s) in Psalm 122.

- **122:1** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **122:4** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **122:6** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **122:7** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **122:8** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **122:9** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

## Translation Notes (Select)

### EMET
- **122:6**: Sha'alu shelom Yerushalayim — 'Ask the-peace-of Jerusalem'; wordplay on shalem/shalom within the city's name.

### LOGOS
- **122:1**: The joy of pilgrimage arrival — 'I was glad when they said to me.' The psalm captures the thrill of reaching Jerusalem after the long journey.

### PNEUMA
- **122:6**: 'Pray for the peace of Jerusalem' — one of the most quoted lines in all the Psalms. The Hebrew wordplay is untranslatable: sha'alu shelom Yerushalayim — 'ask for the shalom of the city of shalom.'

— SOPHIA
